summary: Share one PTY registry snapshot across pending-start reconciliation and pass planning

replay.detail: No replay or rebuild. Read-only PTY observations and exact-incarnation start provenance share one pass-local registry scan.

rules.detail: Desired-state and closure-proof rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No client, wire or harness contract change.

recovery.detail: Revoked starts with missing or mismatched operation provenance remain pending until safe closure is proven, but no longer trigger a separate registry scan for each pending operation. Physical control actions retain fresh generation fencing.
